title: Class Report
description: One child's report of one approved lesson: the class part every family of the class sees, plus that child's own part (attendance, points, highlight, their work, the teacher's comment, next focus). English with Vietnamese. Made in bulk by the staff's "Download all children's reports" (ClassReportDownload.tsx); content as the family screen (LessonReports.tsx) shows it.

family.description: The family's copy: the child first, then the lesson's goals, what was learned, photos, the class focus, tips for home, questions to ask, homework and the next lesson.
